package violations

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http" // want: depguard
	"os"
	"os/exec" // want: depguard
)

// Method keeps the net/http import in use.
const Method = http.MethodGet

// ErrNotFound keeps the os/exec import in use.
var ErrNotFound = exec.ErrNotFound

// ReadWhole reads a user file without safeio's size limit.
func ReadWhole() ([]byte, error) {
	return os.ReadFile("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}

// OpenDirect opens a user file without safeio's symlink checks.
func OpenDirect() (*os.File, error) {
	return os.Open("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}

// Print writes to stdout outside cmd/.
func Print() {
	fmt.Println("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}

// Crash stops protection instead of returning an error.
func Crash() {
	panic("fixture") // want: forbidigo
}

// TODO finish this placeholder. // want: godox

// Separate has a misspelling in its comment: recieve. // want: misspell
func Separate() {}

// IsEOF compares errors with == instead of errors.Is.
func IsEOF(err error) bool {
	return err == io.EOF // want: errorlint
}

// Swallow returns nil after an error.
func Swallow() error {
	if _, err := os.Stat("fixture"); err != nil {
		return nil // want: nilerr
	}
	return errors.New("fixture")
}

// WriteShared writes a file that other users can read.
func WriteShared(b []byte) error {
	return os.WriteFile("fixture", b, 0o644) // want: gosec
}

// Itoa formats an int the slow way.
func Itoa(n int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d", n) // want: perfsprint
}

// Lookup names its parameter against Go's initialism convention.
func Lookup(userId int) int { // want: revive
	return userId
}

// Double calls a helper that ignores one of its parameters.
func Double(n int) int {
	return double(n, 1) + double(n+1, 2)
}

func double(n, unused int) int { // want: unparam, revive
	m := n * 2
	return m + 1
}

// Extend appends to the wrong slice.
func Extend(xs, ys []int) int {
	n := len(xs)
	xs = append(ys, n) // want: gocritic
	return len(xs)
}
